sickLeave.law: Maryland earned sick and safe leave
sickLeave.capKind: hours an employer may limit accrual and use to each year
sickLeave.note: 1 hour per 30 hours worked; an employer may cap accrual at 40 hours a year, use at 64 hours a year and the balance at 64 hours. Paid for employers with 15 or more employees, unpaid below that. Needs checking.
